//: The omniscient view (12 §5): the play screen's map drawn from what is really there, not from what the character has seen. The application acts on the preference named `omniscient` wherever a loaded mod defines one; only a development profile does. Switching it off empties the character's map memory, so that nothing learnt from truth is left behind.
name: See everything
doc: Draw the world as it really is, whatever the character could see. For development.

name: See everything
doc: Switch between what the character sees and what is really there.
